verdict.rationale: Cekura is a voice-agent testing/observability SaaS platform, not an agentic assistant that itself consumes external tools; the evidence only shows Cekura exposing its OWN MCP server for other AI assistants (Claude, Cursor, etc.) to call into, which is the opposite (server) role, not Cekura acting as an MCP client plugging in third-party servers.
